description:
The research findings counted from Hook Detector's shared index of public YouTube data:
    openings (which openings sit before a steeper or flatter first minute of YouTube's "most
    replayed" heatmap, replay intensity, not retention), title-devices (which title devices go with
    higher multiples, by niche) and title-thumbnail-overlap (title and thumbnail word overlap against
    the multiple). Each page with n per run and how many claims reproduced on a second sample of other
    channels, did not, or had too few videos. No key needed; limited per address (429). Free. Same as
    GET /v1/findings.
name: list_research
